bge_reranker.node_purpose: Score every bounded candidate against every compiled RetrievalNeed so one preselected need cannot bias complex financial requests.
bge_reranker.input_scale: Eighteen development atoms plus one 67-object complex-document replay; at most ten needs and ninety-six candidates per atom.
required_outputs: one finite score per candidate-need pair
bge_reranker.schema_burden: pair-score matrix, stable candidate and need identities, cache digest and complete ordering
bge_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: a single wrong need can rank generic metrics, product catalogs or detached table context above evidence-bearing objects
bge_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: v1.4 generic rerankers reached only 2/15 and 4/15 top-ten positives while typed recall and finance-aware shortlist reached 15/15
bge_reranker.reasoning_profile: local cross-encoder scoring without generation, network or training
bge_reranker.stop_and_truncation: 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2, finite matrix and fail closed on score or identity drift

qwen_reranker.node_purpose: Provide an independent local relevance signal over the same all-needs pair matrix without owning financial truth.
qwen_reranker.input_scale: The same bounded candidate-need matrices as BGE, including the 67-object VS2 replay.
required_outputs: one finite score per candidate-need pair
qwen_reranker.schema_burden: instruction-aware pair scores plus deterministic aggregation and cache receipt
qwen_reranker.materiality_and_quality_risk: semantic similarity may prefer a generic risk paragraph or detached row; Evidence Role and typed intent remain separate hard inputs
qwen_reranker.comparable_run_evidence: Qwen found several VS2 structural targets but generic ranking alone did not retain their footnote and restatement context
qwen_reranker.reasoning_profile: local reranker shadow without generation, network or training
qwen_reranker.stop_and_truncation: 1024 tokens per pair, batch 2, finite matrix and fail closed on score or identity drift

why_new_attempt_is_justified: the final v1.1 ontology separates HBM and data-center proxy terms from direct evidence
the reviewed MU qrel successor corrects incomplete reported-results labels without affecting label-blind scoring
VS2 requires the same all-needs scorer plus post-selection bounded context rather than ranking footnotes as standalone evidence
not_changed: compiled object population and model identities
hard identity, period, source and relationship filters
